Which statement correctly describes a physical characteristic of the Moon?

options.A: The Moon is made of hot gases.
options.B: The Moon is covered with many craters.
options.C: The Moon has many bodies of liquid water.
options.D: The Moon has the ability to give off its own light.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - The Moon is covered with many craters.

Which is the most reliable way to get unbiased results when conducting a controlled
experiment?

options.A: Use more than one control group.
options.C: Change the hypothesis if it is incorrect.
options.D: Repeat the procedure exactly the same each time.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Repeat the procedure exactly the same each time.

questions.stem_text:
A species lives in a region that changes over time from temperate to tropical. The
survival of the species will be most probable if the species can do which of the
following?

options.D: emigrate before the change is complete
